content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm looking to enable communication between [product_name] and [product_name]. On the [version_no] side, which block should I use? Is it necessary to use TSEND and TRECEIVE?

You do not need to use TSEND or similar blocks. Simply configure [product_name] so that the sent data is stored in a Data Block (DB) on the [version_no] controller. You can then access the data in the DB as needed.
Hello [user_name], I've tried to set this up but I haven't been successful. Do you have any screenshots, or could you share your email address so I can get assistance?
If possible and you're working with [product_name] Basic [version_no], you can upload your project here for review. Please include both your [product_name] project and any related files.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking clear instructions for setting up communication between two [company_name] PLCs, specifically involving [product_name] modules. Misunderstandings remain regarding which configuration settings and program blocks are required, with some confusion about using standard communication blocks versus utilizing Data Blocks directly. The conversation highlights a need for more accessible documentation and practical examples for common PLC integration tasks.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a step-by-step guide or visual references to configure communication between [product_name] and [version_no], including details about configuring Data Blocks, communication blocks, and relevant programming settings.
